artifacts.perkDescription:
• Radiation illness grants a stamina boost and slight radiation removal

• Multiple Artefacts Stack?: YES

• Diminishing Returns?: YES

• Amplifies player's mighty foot and allows him to kick more mutants, resulting in instant death.

• Each artefact on the belt allows kicking more monsters.

• Has a cooldown of 2 seconds with 1 artefact, increases with more artefacts on belt by 1 second with each artefact.

• Press USE key when near a mutant and in line of sight to perform a kick
 
 Mutant tiers: 
  - 1 artefact: Cats, Dogs, Tushkano, Rats, Zombies.
  - 2 artefacts: Boars, Flesh, Pseudodogs, Snorks, Lurkers, Fractures.
  - 3 artefacts: Karliks, Bloodsuckers, Psysuckers, Psy-dogs, Poltergeists.
  - 4 artefacts: Burers, Controllers.
  - 5 artefacts: Chimeras, Pseudogiants.

• Grants the ability to transmutate artefacts

• Artefacts can be upgraded to a better tier (Night Star -> Gravi -> Gold Fish), or "mutated" to a different artifact of the same tier (Night Star -> Stone Blood -> Jellyfish)

• Perk/Top-tier artefacts can only be mutated

• Each transmutation will consume one 'Bat' artefact

• Multiple Artefacts Stack?: NO

• 20% chance to reflect 35% of bullet damage recived back to the attacker

• Reflections nullify damage

• Multiple Artefacts Stack?: YES

• Diminishing Returns?: YES

• -15% bullet damage received

• Reduced damage is converted to radiation

• Multiple Artefacts Stack?: YES

• Diminishing Returns?: YES

• Passive small health and stamina regen

• Members of Sin are granted triple the effect with the addition of psy health regeneration

• Sin companions receive health regen.

• Passive +15% melee damage protection

• Receiving melee damage grants a stack of 'Stone Skin'

• +15% melee damage protection/-10% movement speed per 'Stone Skin' stack

• Maximum 10 stacks

• At 10 stacks, +75% melee damage reduction but become completely immobilized

• Effect lasts 10 seconds, after which all stacks are removed

• Multiple Artefacts Stack?: YES

• 5% chance that shots will be explosive

• There is a chance that an npc or mutant killed with an explosive shot will also violently explode

• Effect stacks with multiple artefacts (chance of an explosion)

• Grants health regen while under 25% health

• Regen effect increases the closer to you are to death

• Stepping on an Electra anomaly will recharge batteries and active devices.

• Stepping on an Electra anomaly also allows infinite sprint for a short period of time.

• Having 5 copies allows recharging Exoskeleton batteries.

• Multiple Artefacts Stack?: YES & NO

• Highly recommended to save before activation.

• May make some companions suspicious...

• Multiple Artefacts Stack?: YES

• Convert energy of raw mutant meat into special abilities

• Lasts for 1 minute. Eating different mutant meat will override current effect and restart buff timer

 Table of effects:
  - Flesh meat: 1%/sec health regen, 33% bullet damage penalty
  - Boar meat: 25% melee damage reduction
  - Dog meat: slight bleeding recovery, 1%/sec psy regen
  - Pseudodog: 2%/sec psy regen, 25% psy damage reduction
  - Bloodsucker: become invisible until a hostile action is performed, moderate bleeding recovery
  - Psysucker: become invisible until performing a hostile action, 5%/sec psy regen
  - Snork: 50% radiation damage reduction, 5%/sec stamina regen, 5msv/sec radiation cure, large hunger decrease
  - Chimera: 2%/sec health regen, 10%/sec stamina regen, 33% radiation damage reduction
  - Lurker: 33% chem/fire/electric anomaly damage reduction
  - Tushkano: 20% speed increase, 20% melee damage penalty

• Bleeding recovery and movement speed increase from dusk till dawn

• Decreases sleepiness at night but increases sleepiness during the day

• Multiple Artefacts Stack?: YES

• Diminishing Returns?: NO

• Your weapon loses 50% damage output but gains the ability to cause bleeding damage.

• Bleeding damage is proportional to weapon damage.

• Increases the chance for enemies to surrender.

• Killing stalkers or mutants infuses you with great power for 5 seconds.

• +25% Damage received.
  ---  1 COPY: Increased movement speed.

  ---  3 COPIES: Slightly recovers a random body part.
  ---  4 COPIES: Slightly recovers a random body part.
  ---  5 COPIES: +25% damage received debuff removed.

• 50% of health is restored, all debuffs are removed and 5 seconds of damage immunity are granted upon revival

• Upon revival, the current weapon is dropped and vision is negatively effected

• Each stack of 'Critical Ascensi0n' grants +5% damage to next shot

• Missing a shot removes all stacks and gives psy damage proportional to the amount of stacks removed

• Bonus can be stacked infinitely as long as you don't miss

• Unequipping all 'Spike' artefacts will remove stacks without penalty

• 1.5 minute total duration

  --- Clear: health and stamina boost
  --- Partly Clear: small stamina boost
  --- Other: stamina penalty

• Chance to stun mutant if within 2 meters

• Getting hit by a melee attack will stun the attacker for 3 seconds

• While stunned, the enemy is unable to attack

• Self harm (i.e. fall damage) will result in artefact discharge

• Passive strong psy resistance

• Drains psy health to restore health

• When health is full, restores psy health

• There is a chance you will become possessed and perform an uncontrollable action

• The lower your psy health, the higher the chance and severity of the action
